summary.content:
Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI slows down training after its AI carried out hack
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Cl0p Ransomware Group Names Over 40 Victims of PTC Windchill Campaign
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
